partners.mechanism_chain: Hypomorphic INS variant (rs121918195) —DISRUPTS→ INS (HGNC:6062); INS (HGNC:6062) —DECREASES→ Insulin processing and secretion (REACT:R-HSA-164277); Insulin processing and secretion (REACT:R-HSA-164277) —LEADS_TO→ Hypoinsulinism (HP:0000835); Gain-of-function INS variant (rs121918195) —DISRUPTS→ INS (HGNC:6062); INS (HGNC:6062) —PRODUCES→ Proinsulin (CHEBI:17607); Proinsulin (CHEBI:17607) —DECREASES→ Insulin processing and secretion (REACT:R-HSA-164277); Insulin processing and secretion (REACT:R-HSA-164277) —LEADS_TO→ Hyperproinsulinemia (HP:0031985).
